registration.title: Who can sign in
registration.open: Open: anyone signing in with a new email gets an account of their own, with the User role.
registration.inviteOnly: Invite only: only people an administrator added can sign in. Nobody else gets a code.

confirm.openDescription: From the moment you confirm, anyone with a valid email will be able to create an account and sign in without you adding them. You can switch back whenever you want.
confirm.inviteOnlyDescription: From the moment you confirm, only people you add can sign in. Everyone who already has an account keeps signing in: to lock someone out, deactivate their account.
